title: AI Visibility Pyramid
content: The AI Visibility Pyramid is a framework from the agency Animalz that places traditional SEO at the base, context and content strategy in the middle, and trust and authority signals at the top.

meta.why: The layers suggest an order of work. Start with the search basics a page needs, then move to content and reputation work.
meta.example: A team fixes indexing problems on its product pages before commissioning new articles or seeking mentions in trade publications.
meta.check: Sort your open search tasks into the three layers and confirm the base layer has no unresolved problems.
meta.limitation: The pyramid is one agency's model, and search engines and AI companies do not use it as a standard.
meta.sources: Animalz: AEO glossary | https://animalz.co/blog/aeo-glossary | Industry glossary
